description:
The codebase has accumulated significant type checking errors that are currently
ignored in the ty configuration. These represent technical debt that reduces
the value of type checking and should be addressed incrementally.

UPDATE (2026-01-16): Full analysis completed. 5 quick-win rules enabled as errors (56 fixes).

CRITICAL FINDING: Remaining 7 rules have ~4,000+ errors (not ~2,600 as estimated).
Most stem from intentional dynamic typing patterns in DataFrame adapters and
benchmark inheritance hierarchies. These are false positives requiring major
architectural refactoring to "fix" - not appropriate for type: ignore comments.
